label: negative coordination: neither this nor that
note: CLOSED BY CHAPTER 109, AND THE OLD NOTE'S BLOCKER WAS ALREADY GONE. 'Untaught, and it depends on the missing coordinator at ML-A1-JOIN-01' predates chapter 70, which teaches -um across four lessons (2390-2420); the note was never re-read against it. The construction itself was censused BY SHAPE rather than by the English word -- a regex for two -um-marked words followed by a negative returns ZERO across the corpus, while grepping 'neither' finds only ordinary English prose. NO NEW VOCABULARY: Malayalam builds it from -um on every item plus a negative at the end, and both halves are long taught (illa at sequence 40, alla at chapter 77). TWO LESSONS RATHER THAN ONE, because ML-C77-alla teaches that Malayalam makes you choose a negative where English spends one word on both, and 'neither ... nor' hides that choice: caayayum kaappiyum ILLA against adhyaapakanum vaidyanum ALLA, identical on the left and different only in the last word. ML-A1-JOIN-04 (distributive) and ML-A1-JOIN-01's clause half remain open and are NOT claimed here; this point is negative coordination only.
